articles.summary: Manila, November 10, 2026 - VinFast officially launches the All-New VF 8 and announces its pricing in the Philippines.
articles.title: VINFAST LAUNCHES THE ALL-NEW VF 8 IN THE PHILIPPINES

articles.summary: Vientiane, November 10, 2026 – Green SM has entered into Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) with 10 strategic partners in Laos, spanning the banking and finance, telecommunications, payment, media, and hospitality sectors.
articles.title: GREEN SM FORGES PARTNERSHIPS WITH 10 STRATEGIC PARTNERS TO EXPAND ITS GREEN MOBILITY ECOSYSTEM IN LAOS

articles.summary: Jakarta, November 23, 2026 – Marking two years of operations in Indonesia, Green SM has officially launched the “Need a Cab? Call Green SM” campaign, kicking off with the special “G2EEN SEASON” promotion offering a 25% discount on all-electric taxi fares.
articles.title: GREEN SM CELEBRATES SECOND ANNIVERSARY IN INDONESIA WITH “G2EEN SEASON” PROMOTION, OFFERING SPECIAL FARE DISCOUNTS

articles.summary: Manila, November 13, 2026 - VinFast officially introduces the VF 3 Plus and VF 3 Eco in the Philippines, adding technology, safety and convenience features to the country’s best-selling battery electric vehicle. Notably, the VF 3 Plus offers a more premium option for a new generation of customers seeking a fully equipped driving experience from day one.
articles.title: VINFAST PHILIPPINES INTRODUCES VF 3 PLUS AND VF 3 ECO, BRINGING MORE STYLE AND CHOICE TO A NEW GENERATION OF CUSTOMERS
